about: What gen_matrix.mjs cannot read from tauri/catalog/components.json: where each component comes from on Windows and on macOS/Linux (tauri/src/install/**, docs/app/CATALOG.md §1 and §2), the targets where it is a conda environment that does not follow the kit (Installer::relocatable false: reinstalled from the kept packages after a move, D-92, D-118) and a note shown when the catalog does not offer it on a target. Every catalog component has an entry; test/rust/install/mod.rs checks the ids and notRelocatable against the installers.

llama.windows: GitHub ggml-org/llama.cpp, build fixed in the catalog (Vulkan + CPU)
llama.unix: GitHub ggml-org/llama.cpp, build fixed in the catalog (Vulkan + CPU on Linux, Metal on macOS)

git.unix: dugite-native (relocatable; prepared separately if the PC cannot run the target)

php.windows: windows.php.net Thread Safe x64 + local VC++
php.unix: static-php-cli bulk (cli + fpm), 8.4 and 8.5 pinned in sha256ByFile

apache.unix: the kit's own build httpd-v<v> (php-fpm), SHA-256 pinned in sha256ByLine

rust.windows: rustup: gnu host (the C/C++ linker), msvc from Rust's page in Tools

cc.unix: shim over zig cc + GNU make (conda-forge)

mongodb.unix: macOS: MongoDB builds; Linux: server from conda-forge; the vendor's mongosh and Database Tools

mongo-express.windows: GitHub nabre/atollo, the kit's build (pure JavaScript)
mongo-express.unix: GitHub nabre/atollo, the kit's build (pure JavaScript)

vscodium-server.unix: VSCodium reh-web, pinned version per target

conpty.windows: NuGet Microsoft.Windows.Console.ConPTY, pinned version, conpty.dll + OpenConsole.exe signed by Microsoft (x64)

sandboxes.windows: GitHub docker/sbx-releases: DockerSandboxes.msi (per user) extracted with msiexec /a, never installed
sandboxes.unix: GitHub docker/sbx-releases: Sbx.app on Apple silicon; the static tarball laid out as its install.sh on Linux x64 and arm64
